title: SocialEngagementRawEvent
description: Source-agnostic raw engagement event matching RawEvent in event.go, published by any producer onto social.engagement.raw

event_id.description: Unique identifier for this raw event

collected_at.description: Timestamp when the event was ingested

occurred_at.description: Timestamp when the content was published on origin platform, if known

account_source.description: Our application user, client ID, or agent that published this event

creator.description: The original content author or owner on origin platform, if known

content_url.description: Canonical URL of the content item

captions.description: Primary post text, title, or caption

media_urls.description: Direct media URLs (supports carousels and multi-image posts)

likes_count.description: Likes, upvotes, or equivalent positive signal count

comments_count.description: Total count of comments or replies

comments.description: Sample or full comments text if available

avg_watch_time_seconds.description: Average watch time in seconds (permanent null for unowned Instagram media)

content_length_seconds.description: Duration of video or audio in seconds

payload.description: Escape hatch for raw platform-specific fields that do not map cleanly above (json.RawMessage)
